scope: Install and load Fedora’s GTK 3 global menu exporter, including on Fedora derivatives.

checks.command: Ran the exhaustive package mapping, GTK login hook and global menu installer tests in a network-isolated Bubblewrap sandbox. All 451 tests passed.

In a disposable Fedora 45 container, installed unity-gtk3-module from Fedora, detected its packaged library, sourced the generated Plasma login hook and confirmed that native GTK 3 loaded the library in a private Xvfb and D-Bus session.
Verified the regenerated component fingerprint ledger and reviewed the integration with git diff --check.

coverage_limits: The native check establishes module loading in Fedora 45 under isolated X11. It does not exercise menu display in a full Plasma desktop.
